title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.

## What the record says
- Framing: Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record.
- Live starts: v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026.
- First live signal: An ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close.
- ATOM result: ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip.
- NEAR: A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since.
- Expectation: In testing about two trades in three lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.
- Where to check: The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.
